Name: Transparent Tiles
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This is a simple mod as an alternative to PyTK's map tile transparency functionality.

It works the same, just add @Opacity as a float-type tile property. 1 = full opacity, 0 = full transparency.


The screenshot shows this being used with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6540]Show Players Behind Map Tiles[/url].


[size=5][b]Technical[/b][/size]

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI[/url].

Code is at [url=https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods]https://github.com/aedenthorn/StardewValleyMods[/url].
